title: Painted Wood
text: Painted Wood. This is my favorite style of incense holder. However, the paint on these makes them look really cheap. You can obviously tell the holes are haphazardly drilled. The wood version just looks a lot better in person. I like the size. I like the tray style. Just something about the painted wood just looks really cheap and not very nice.

product_metadata.title: Folkulture Incense Holder or Insense Stick Holder, Modern Insence Burner for Sticks or Ash Catcher for Home Décor, Handmade Wooden Incense Tray Trough for Sticks, Mango Wood, Blue
features: PERFECT INCENSE HOLDER- 12 inch long and 4 inch wide incense burner is perfect enough to catch all the ash so that it creates no mess and easy to empty and clean. Perfect for high volume incense users.

BURNS TWO INCENSE STICKS TOGETHER- The two holes at its two ends enable us to light and place two insence sticks at the same time, making the surroundings filled with aroma. Standard size incense stick can easily fit in these holes.

STYLISH & BEAUTIFULLY HANDCRAFTED- This handmade wooden inscent holder has a beautiful finish on top and brown rustic finish from the outside. This Ash Catcher is a complete eye-catcher and sure to receive compliments for its stylish, elegant, antique, classy and modern look.
INCENSE EMITS POSTIVE VIBES- Positive energy is released in your surroundings which helps you to stay calm and meditate peacefully.
MODERN GIFT- Our Incense burner holder is a suitable gifting choice for housewarmings as it can also be used as potpourri dish holder to fill your place with pleasing fragrance.
